t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pairs of gnomes will be presented in the same set of colours. For one of them I will get a higher reward consistently (one in each set). The gnome giving the highest ratings sometimes swaps. So when I see the gnome not giving me the higher rate anymore I need to swap to the other gnome. If one set of gnomes swaps they all swap the same.

vb_textbox.text: You will see pairs of gnomes. The pairs come in the same sets of colours and one goes higher reward than the other. If you notice a gnome isn't giving the high rate anymore, switch and stay consistent in picking that gnome until it doesn't give you the high rate anymore, and switch, and so on. There is some logic between the pairs too. If one set of gnomes switch they all switch at the same time. So if you picked red but then notice it switched to yellow as the higher scoring gnome then switch the logic for the next pair, and so on.
